description.value: Woking Dragon is a family-owned Chinese restaurant operating since 2003, known for western-style Chinese cuisine with a modern twist on tradition. The brand has been voted favourite Chinese food in Coquitlam and offers online ordering across its locations. Touring cyclists would find familiar comfort-food options with some vegan and gluten-free adaptations available.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Woking Dragon is an active restaurant with online ordering (evidence for takeout) and explicitly states 'Some menu items are able to be made Vegan & Gluten-Free.' However, the website lists only three locations — Coquitlam, Maple Ridge, and Langley — with no North Vancouver location, and the OSM name 'Woking Dragon China Bistro' does not match the website's consistent branding 'Woking Dragon Chop Suey House.' The OSM coordinates (49.284, -122.810) place this node in the Coquitlam/Port Moody area, not North Vancouver, suggesting both the community field and possibly the name tag are inaccurate.
